Do you have any problems like this?

  • Noticeable wrinkles all over the face
  • Fine wrinkles have increased
  • I want to restore the moisture and firmness of my skin
  • I'm concerned about dry skin
  • I want to brighten the tone of my face
  • Pores are noticeable
  • I'm worried about dullness

What is water light injection? Site care 532 injections handled at our hospital

Water light injection is a skin beautification treatment that originated in South Korea, a beauty powerhouse. Beauty ingredients are injected using an ultra-fine needle.
The main ingredient is "non-crosslinked hyaluronic acid" with high moisturizing power, and in addition to this, vitamin C, placenta, CoQ10, etc. can be customized.
By finely injecting it into the dermis and epidermis, it leads to moisturized and firm skin, and can be expected to improve fine lines and wrinkles. The injection is done using a very thin needle, so there is almost no pain.

Many people feel the effects after just one treatment, but the difference becomes even more noticeable if you repeat the treatment 3 to 4 times. Of course, regular treatments will provide the longest lasting effect.
Skin that is full of moisture and firmness is called ``water-glow skin'' in Korea. Would you like to aim for water-light skin with water-light injections at our clinic?

Cytocare 532 injection

A cell regeneration injection containing highly concentrated hyaluronic acid, 23 types of amino acids, 13 types of vitamins, 5 types of nucleic acids, 6 types of enzymes, 6 types of minerals, and antioxidants.
By injecting abundant skin-beautifying ingredients, we can completely resolve your skin concerns and symptoms.

Main effect
  • Restores skin moisture and firmness
  • Promotes skin cell production
  • Inhibits generation of active oxygen
  • Improved metabolism
  • skin moisturizing effect
  • Promotes elastin and collagen production

Expected effects of water light injection

Although it depends on the customized drug, the following effects can be expected with water light injections whose main ingredient is non-crosslinked hyaluronic acid.

  • Improving skin moisture and firmness
  • Promote collagen production
  • Improvement of crepe and fine wrinkles
  • Improving skin regeneration power
  • Skin aging care effect

When can I feel the effects? How long does it last?

After the temporary redness immediately after the treatment, the effect will appear in about 3 days to 1 week. After that, the effects will last for about 2 months. We recommend performing 3 to 4 treatments over 2 to 3 weeks, and then moving to every 1 to 2 months. We believe that you will experience the most efficient and long-lasting effects.

Advantages and disadvantages of water light injection

Benefits

  • Can restore moisture and firmness to your skin
  • Medications can be customized according to your concerns
  • Treatment time is about 20 minutes
  • It is easy to feel the effect after just one treatment

Disadvantages

  • There may be temporary redness at the injection site immediately after the procedure.
  • Temporary internal bleeding may occur

Is water light injection painful? What are the side effects and downtime?

At our hospital, we have introduced a machine called "Introfill," which uses ultra-fine needles.
It also has the ability to inject while gently suctioning the skin, making it possible to inject water with minimal pain and internal bleeding.
If the pain is severe, the length of the needle can be adjusted (shortened), so it is unlikely that you will have to give up on the treatment due to the pain.

Side effects/risks

  • Redness, swelling, and a rash may occur, but this usually subsides within a week.
  • If internal bleeding occurs, it will take about two weeks for it to completely subside.
  • Although it is extremely unlikely, infection and pigmentation may occur.

Downtime and precautions

Treatment time: about 20 minutes
Downtime: About 3 days to 1 week *There are individual differences

  • Make-up can be applied from the next day onwards.
  • You can take a shower or bath from the same day. When washing your face, do not rub it too hard, just rinse it off with lukewarm water.
  • Please refrain from saunas, hot springs, etc. for a while.

Clarification of information related to safety in other countries

In Japan, this product has not been approved under the Pharmaceutical and Medical Device Act.

About the acquisition route

All items are purchased from domestic distributors.
*Reference: Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare's guidance regarding personal imports
https://www.yakubutsu.mhlw.go.jp/individualimport/healthhazard/

Other domestically approved drugs with the same ingredients and efficacy

There are no other domestically approved drugs that have the same ingredients and performance.
*This will be a free medical treatment.

What is Juvelook injection?

Juvelook injection is a skin-growth injection whose main ingredients are PDLLA (polylactic acid) and non-crosslinked hyaluronic acid. By finely injecting the drug inside the skin, it stimulates collagen production, aiming to improve skin firmness and elasticity, enlarged pores, fine wrinkles, acne scars, and uneven skin. Unlike treatments that add volume such as hyaluronic acid injections, this treatment is suitable for those who want to improve their skin quality. After the procedure, you may experience temporary redness, swelling, internal bleeding, pain, and swelling. Since the appearance and duration of effects vary from person to person, we will propose a treatment plan tailored to each patient's concerns and skin condition.

Expected effects of Juvelook injection

  • Improving skin firmness, elasticity, and thickness
  • Improvement of acne scars (craters) and enlarged pores
  • Improves the appearance of wrinkles on the forehead, between the eyebrows, neck, etc.
  • Improving skin moisture retention
  • Promote resynthesis of collagen and elastic fibers

Juvelook injection side effects and downtime

Side effects/risks

  • Inflammation (redness, edema, erythema) along with itching and pain may appear at the injection site and may last for about a week.

Downtime and precautions

Treatment time: about 20 minutes
Downtime: About 1 to 2 weeks *There are individual differences

  • Make-up can be applied from the next day onwards.
  • You can take a shower or bath from the same day. When washing your face, do not rub it too hard, just rinse it off with lukewarm water.
  • Please refrain from saunas, hot springs, etc. for a while.
